Apple Lossless Audio Codec (ALAC) decoder (no encoder — encoders for ALAC are out of scope; Symphonia ships decode-only too).

Ports symphonia-codec-alac (MagicCookie from symphonia-common apple/audio/alac): 24/48-byte magic cookie (with frma/alac atom prefix skips) incl. CoreAudio channel-layout mapping, SCE/CPE/LFE/ DSE/FIL raw framing, subframe Rice coding with history + zero runs, LPC prediction with adaptive coefficients, mid-side decorrelation, tail-bit reattachment. Output is planar sfS32, left-justified to 32 bits. Bitstream is MSB-first (LtrBitReader).
